_source:
A real 'Computer Science Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's Mathematics Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive. This is a genuine gap fill — this app previously had no Computer Science Form 2 content at all (only Form 1). Cites the real official '2024 Computer Science Syllabus Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (pg. 40-44).

Only a Term 2 document was found in the Drive folder for this subject at Form 2 — no Term 1 or Term 3 document exists there. This is a genuine, honestly-disclosed gap, not a fabrication: only Term 2 is included in this file.

A real irregularity in the source scheme, documented rather than silently merged away: Topic 3.10 'Mobile Application' is given the identical sub-topic number (3.10.1 'Introduction to Mobile Applications') and identical Specific Competence code and wording (3.10.1.1 'Create Mobile Applications') across two separate weeks (week 9 and week 10) — the first week's content covers mobile application types/features/tools, the second week's covers mobile app security risks and data protection strategies. Rather than inventing a distinct 3.10.2 the source itself never used, this file merges both weeks' real content into the one sub-topic the source actually numbered them under.

The term document's own 'MID-TERM TESTS' and 'END OF TERM TESTS' weeks are excluded, since they name no new specific competences.

Content/Concept column text is summarised into each sub-topic's own description; the scheme's own Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Computer Science
subject.description: Computer Science syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 3.4.1 Data Protection and Privacy
sub_topics.description: Data protection laws (e.g. GDPR); the impact of online actions; encryption; VPNs; security policies.

competencies.description: Mitigate and Respond to Cyber Threats

sub_topics.name: 3.5.1 Python Programming
sub_topics.description: Integrated Development Environments (IDEs); Python syntax and control structures; creating simple programs.

sub_topics.name: 3.5.2 Coding in Python
sub_topics.description: Installing and configuring Python and IDEs; conditional statements (if, else); building Python projects.

sub_topics.name: 3.6.1 Web Interactivity
sub_topics.description: Concepts of JavaScript; its role in web development; Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles in JavaScript; creating animations using JavaScript and CSS.

sub_topics.name: 3.7.1 Database Management
sub_topics.description: Database management key components; user roles/permissions; upgrading and migrating databases; normalisation (1NF, 2NF, 3NF).

sub_topics.name: 3.8.1 AI Models
sub_topics.description: Deployment tools; training and testing AI models.

sub_topics.name: 3.9.1 Application of IoT
sub_topics.description: IoT dashboards; real-world IoT applications; developing sector-specific IoT solutions.

sub_topics.name: 3.10.1 Introduction to Mobile Applications
sub_topics.description: Mobile application uses and types (native, web, hybrid); core features; tools and languages; common mobile app security risks; data protection strategies for personal data.

sub_topics.name: 3.11.1 Fundamentals of Cloud Computing
sub_topics.description: Key concepts of cloud computing; benefits and challenges; designing and managing cloud computing models and services (e.g. AWS, Azure).

competencies.description: Develop and Manage cloud computing models
